'undef' values are things that do not have specified contents.

detaileddescription.para: These are used for a variety of purposes, including global variable initializers and operands to instructions. 'undef' values can occur with any first-class type.
Undef values aren't exactly constants; if they have multiple uses, they can appear to have different bit patterns at each use. See LangRef.html#undefvalues for details.
